pre-query.caption: Source filter rail — 8 facets with counts. An infrastructure taxonomy: 4 labels name a system, 3 a content type, 1 is leftovers.
Prompt chips — all four are vendor-voiced sales questions, not visitor questions.
Suggestions — generic in the empty state. No recent or popular searches, no personalisation.

autocomplete.caption: Facet counts recompute per keystroke. At 'ecom' this reads Support 1,695 and Academy 142 — every record in both sources.
Suggestions switch from generic to query-derived.

post-query.caption: Hit card: thumbnail, title, 'Source • category', 'Learn more →'. No breadcrumb, no snippet, no date, no highlighting.
Facets recomputed for the query — sums to the stated result count.

ai-mode.caption: Algolia Assist, triggered by Enter — no AI-mode click needed. The answer is generative and carries no citations, and never links to the results retrieved directly above it.
Retrieved results stay on screen, above the answer, unconnected to it.
Filter rail still live behind the chat.

zero-result.caption: 'No results'. No did-you-mean, no spelling correction, no query relaxation — the keyword-search recovery affordances are absent.
The filter rail EMPTIES — 0 facet items. The left column goes blank.
Suggestions revert to the generic four, unrelated to what was typed.
But it is not a dead end: pressing Enter auto-engages Algolia Assist, which answers the failed query with a structured recovery menu. The AI is the fallback.
